clips.title: The story
paras: In Skull Rock, the Tablet of Verga lies in Burning Blade hands, its demonic runes sought by warlocks in Orgrimmar.

The Tablet of Verga bears ritual runes for summoning creatures of the Nether and bending them to a master's will. The Burning Blade cult stole the stone and hid it in a chest inside Skull Rock, just east of Orgrimmar. Warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow seek it to study the markings and learn to summon a voidwalker. Recovering it also keeps the cult from gaining that same advantage.
